title: How Many More? Word Problems
intro: Show how counting on finds the amount needed to reach a target.
html:
Teaching notes for parents and teachers

How to teach it

Build the starting amount and add counters until the target is reached. Count only the newly added counters.

Ask your student

Which counters tell us how many more were needed?

If your student needs help

If the student gives the target as the answer, separate the starting counters from those added.

Choosing and using the worksheet

Each set contains four questions with positive additions and targets within twenty. In each strip, the filled spaces show the start and the empty spaces show room left before reaching the target. Shade the extra spaces, write an equation, and record the amount added. The answer key colors those extra spaces separately.
